collections.name: Inside the Witch's Hut
collections.intro: Come a little closer, my dear… Within these walls lie treasures for sacred spaces and shadowy corners. For the well-practised or the simply curious, there's a little magic here for everyone.

collections.name: Oddities
collections.intro: Not everything in the hut fits neatly into a category. Curious little finds: strange, charming, and impossible to ignore.

collections.name: Mythical Creatures
collections.intro: Born of legend, lore and long-told tales. Each one is crafted with care and character, for those drawn to magic, mischief and stories that linger.

collections.name: Woodland & Mystical Friends
collections.intro: A gentle gathering of creatures from forest floors and far-off realms. Perfect for cosy spaces, curious hearts, and those most at home among moss, myth and make-believe.

collections.name: Scare Gang
collections.intro: A mismatched gang of mythical creatures, each with their own tale to tell. A little spooky, a little sweet, and full of personality. Patterns by Rikki Gustafson.

collections.name: A Gathering of Misfits
collections.intro: A curious little collection of odd creatures, gathered along the way. Each one a touch strange, full of charm, character and a hint of mischief.

collections.name: Horror
collections.intro: For those drawn to the darker corners of the imagination. Inspired by classic horror, unsettling tales and things best discovered after dark.

collections.name: Wearables
collections.intro: Not all magic is meant to sit on a shelf. Made to follow you out into the world, adding a little charm, warmth and whimsy wherever you roam.

collections.name: Felt Creations
collections.intro: Made slowly, one stitch at a time. Gentle in nature and rich in character, bringing warmth, texture and a touch of quiet magic to any space.

collections.name: Adults Only
collections.intro: Some things are not meant for little eyes. Grown-up curiosities: bold, cheeky and a little provocative. Crafted for those who like their magic with a wink.

items.name: Nosferatu
items.description: A term often tied to vampires, from the iconic 1922 German silent film “Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror”. Its Count Orlok was based on Bram Stoker's “Dracula”.

items.name: Slender Man
items.description: A modern internet urban legend, born on the Something Awful forums in 2009: a tall, thin figure with a featureless face, a dark suit and elongated limbs.

items.name: Cyclopes
items.description: Giant, one-eyed creatures of Greek mythology, known for their strength and craftsmanship, and said to have forged Zeus' thunderbolts.

items.name: Zombie
items.description: A lurching, groaning soul with a penchant for brains and an undying love for decomposing fashion trends. Rooted in Haitian voodoo folklore.

items.name: Sandworm
items.description: A whimsical, oversized tube of desert whimsy that roams the dunes with wiggly grace and loves underground hide-and-seek.

items.name: Jackalope
items.description: The legendary antlered rabbit of North American folklore, rarely seen, often bragged about.

items.name: Mothman
items.description: A humanoid figure with large wings and glowing red eyes, from 1960s sightings around Point Pleasant, West Virginia. Also comes as a mini.

items.name: Purple People Eater
items.description: The one-eyed, one-horned, flying purple people eater of Sheb Wooley's 1958 novelty song.

items.name: Boogeyman
items.description: The mythical monster found in folklore across many cultures, said to lurk in the shadows or under beds.

items.name: Mermaid
items.description: Upper body of a human, tail of a fish. The enchanting sea-dwellers of maritime legends worldwide.

items.name: Fairies
items.description: Ancient beings of European folklore, said to dwell in forests, lakes and meadows, linked in Celtic myth to the Otherworld.

items.name: Mini Mothman
items.description: All the glowing-eyed mystery of the Mothman, in a pocket-sized package.

items.name: Cthulhu
items.description: One of the Great Old Ones: an octopus head of writhing feelers, clawed feet and long narrow wings. It's said to look upon it means certain death.

items.name: Nessie
items.description: The Loch Ness Monster of Scottish folklore: long-necked, humped, and forever just out of frame.

items.name: 3 Headed Ghost
items.description: A spectral apparition with three faces, each with its own mood, inspired by Cerberus, the three-headed guardian of the underworld.

items.name: Kitsune
items.description: Trickster foxes of Japanese folklore: a type of yōkai with godlike powers.

items.name: Chupacabra
items.description: The “goat sucker”: the vampire-like creature of Puerto Rican sightings in the late 1980s and early '90s.

items.name: Werewolf
items.description: Human by day, howling by full moon. The shapeshifter of countless legends.

items.name: The Greys
items.description: The classic extraterrestrial visitors: big heads, big black eyes, and a lot of curiosity about Earth.

items.name: Leshy
items.description: A Slavic forest spirit said to dwell in the deepest woods, embodying the forest's wild and mysterious essence.

items.name: Chimera
items.description: Greek myth's monstrous hybrid: a lion's body, a goat's head on its back, and a serpent's tail.

items.name: Centaur
items.description: Half human, half horse: wild, strong and skilled in hunting and battle.

items.name: Medusa
items.description: The Gorgon with snakes for hair, whose gaze turns people to stone.

items.name: Minotaur
items.description: The bull-headed guardian of the Cretan labyrinth.

items.name: Dragons
items.description: Small dragons with big personalities. Hoarders of treasure (and yarn).

items.name: Gargoyle
items.description: Stone-faced protectors that keep watch from the rooftops.

items.description: Lady Voodoo and Bluedoo Voodoo together.
